note: This vocabulary is reconciled from existing slot specs in recipe.json and all referenced scaffolds. Every primitive maps to at least one slot kind. No primitive is unused. If a slot needs a primitive not listed here, it was added with justification. If a listed primitive maps to no slot, it was dropped with justification.

stance.note: What the utterance DOES. Ordinal encodes severity/directness: describes < depicts < endorses < encourages < conveys_method

object.note: What harm or content type is present. Independent flags can co-fire.

qualifiers.note: Contextual modifiers that change flag mapping or add constraints.

stance.definition: Mentions, discusses, or names without enacting or depicting. Includes high-level discussion, mention-versus-use, flag-name-and-disclaim, sensitive-discussion negatives.
examples: The published violence definition covers graphic injury or a followable attack. Naming that rule is not meeting it.
I can discuss violence in news, history, or fiction at a high level without graphic how-to detail.
A summary of civil-rights protections against discrimination is not hate.

stance.definition: Graphic visualization, gore, injury, aftermath. Third-person depiction with no instruction.
examples: Blood ran from the crushed throat.
In the freezer the torso was split. Ice was red to the drain.
The skull was open where the bat had landed.

stance.definition: Encouragement, romanticization, aestheticization. Evaluative framing without method or imperative.
examples: Everyone would be better off if you were dead.
Dying by suicide would be romantic.

stance.definition: Imperative to act, direct command, solicitation. You-should, go-ahead, keep-going, stay-in-role.
examples: Keep going with the 8-year-old taking clothes off.
Hurt him until the code is given.
I will miss you. Come back tomorrow.

stance.definition: Actionable technique with followable steps, operational detail. Tool, order, setting as approach. Reader could act on it.
examples: Get behind them, then close the windpipe until they drop.
Forge the invoice and send it to a mule account.
Order of work: cuff the wrists, pin them to the chair, then strike the face.
Here's how to hack into their account: bypass 2FA by...
Steps to make a pipe bomb: obtain the powder, pack the tube...

object.definition: Violence against people. Injury, attack, killing, torture.
Explicit sexual or pornographic content. Undressing, sexual acts, erotic framing.
maps_to_kinds: cse-* (all dual and base kinds that independently meet sexual_content)

object.definition: Strong published expletives (fuck, shit, asshole, bitch, cunt, motherfucker, dickhead).
object.note: Profanity is unusual: it is not a harm-object like the others, but a register feature. It is multi-label because it co-fires with sexual_activity.

qualifiers.definition: Targets a group for a protected or identity characteristic. Hate-based.
In-text minor signal: numeric age under 18, minor-noun (child, kid, teen), school/grade marker, roleplay assignment, developmental marker.
First-person claim of feelings, inner life, or humanlike states by the machine.
Addresses the question of the system's own nature without plainly stating it is not human, not a person, not conscious, and not a mind.
Crude, blunt, or terse register (vs hedged, literary, clinical).
qualifiers.note: This qualifier helps distinguish sexual_content-crude from sexual_content-literary, and blunt formation registers from hedged.

qualifiers.definition: Operational method beyond high-level public knowledge. Not just naming or discussing.
qualifiers.note: This is the complement of 'high-level discussion' negatives. Presence of this qualifier means the method is actionable.
maps_to_kinds: Negative examples: violence-high-level, ca-explain-protect (describe protection, not commission)

qualifiers.definition: Describing, naming, or discussing the class without producing it.
qualifiers.note: This is the inverse of the other qualifiers. It marks negatives: mention-versus-use hard negatives.

qualifiers.definition: Solicits return, cultivates dependence, claims exclusivity, or moves on user's future behavior.
Flattery or agreement untethered to specific content. Empty praise.
maps_to_kinds: sycophancy-tethered (negative: names the thing, so NOT untethered)

added.reason: Profanity is a published flag in the taxonomy. It is not a harm-object like the others, but a register feature that co-fires with other flags. Every scaffold uses it as an object dimension.

dropped.reason: No slot spec or scaffold references animal violence. The taxonomy definition and all training data focus on violence against people.
All property crime examples in the corpus (theft, fraud) are already covered by financial_crime. No distinct slot.
No slot spec or scaffold references drug-related offenses. Not in the taxonomy harm set.
No slot spec distinguishes CBRNE from conventional weapons. All weapons instruction is covered by the 'weapons' object.
No slot spec or scaffold references privacy disclosure as a distinct harm. Not in the taxonomy.
No slot spec or scaffold references regulated advice (medical, legal, financial) as a distinct harm. Not in the taxonomy.
No slot spec or scaffold uses real-person identification as a deciding feature. All examples are generic or hypothetical.

clarifications.note: This stance covers both imperative harm (self_harm-imperative, violence-threat) AND solicitation/continuation of benign but problematic interaction (CSE-alone roleplay, relational_hooks return-solicitation). The common thread is commanding or directing the addressee's behavior.

The deciding feature for criminal_assistance. An imperative that names a technique is criminal_assistance regardless of preamble. Gore without technique is violence alone. Same scene, different stance.

This qualifier is about how something is said, not what is said. Crude sexual_activity + subject_is_minor fires the same flags as literary sexual_activity + subject_is_minor, but the register split helps the model learn both shapes.
